title: Scheduled maintenance
description: Announce planned downtime on the dashboard and the public status page, and optionally hold automatic deploys during it.
notConfigured: Scheduled maintenance is not available on this control plane.

empty.title: No maintenance planned
empty.description: Schedule a window before you take something offline so users see it ahead of time.

banner.freeze: Automatic deploys are held during the window.

form.title: Schedule maintenance
form.description: Times are in your browser time zone ({{zone}}).
form.name: Title
form.leadHint: Sent through your notification channels once. Use 0 for no announcement.
form.freeze: Hold automatic deploys during the window
form.badRange: The end must be after the start.

domainBanner.title: Maintenance mode is on for {{domain}}
domainBanner.titleNotEnforced: Maintenance is saved for {{domain}} but not enforced
domainBanner.body: Visitors see the maintenance page and nothing else: scripts, styles and images are not served. The app keeps running and a deploy does not end maintenance.
domainBanner.bodyNotEnforced: Visitors may still reach the app: the proxy in front of this domain is not proven to send its traffic to the built-in ingress. Open Manage for details.
domainBanner.more_one: {{count}} more domain is in maintenance mode.
domainBanner.more_other: {{count}} more domains are in maintenance mode.
domainBanner.autoOff: Switches off on its own at {{date}}.
domainBanner.noEnd: No automatic end: it stays on until you end it.

confirm.title: Put {{domain}} into maintenance?
confirm.description: Visitors will not reach the app until you end maintenance. Check the page below first.
confirm.visitors: Visitors get a 503 maintenance page with a Retry-After header, on every URL of this domain.
confirm.assets: Scripts, styles, images and API calls are not served either, so the page cannot load anything from the app.
confirm.running: The container keeps running and is not restarted.
confirm.deploys: A deploy during maintenance keeps maintenance on until you end it.
confirm.alerts: Alerts and uptime checks are not muted. Probes on the readiness path still reach the app unless you turned that off.
confirm.autoOff: It switches off by itself after {{hours}} hours.
confirm.noEnd: It has no automatic end. Set an end time or a maximum duration so it cannot be left on.

preview.title: Preview of the page visitors see
preview.caption: Preview: status {{status}}, Retry-After {{retry}} seconds
preview.failed: The preview could not be loaded.
